name: prekey-message-rejections
description: Pre-key message variants and the oracle responder outcome. Each starts from a valid oracle message; the label names the change. reason classifies the error the oracle returned, and failure_reason classifies the per-session reason the oracle logged, in neutral words chosen by the CRS author. The last case was built entirely by the generator with no post-quantum field and message keys derived without salt; it is rejected before any MAC check.

outputs.reason: version 3 not accepted for a new session
KEM fields missing in a version 4 message
only one of the two KEM fields present
malformed protocol buffer or missing required field

outputs.failure_reason: post-quantum field missing (peer version below minimum)
